summary: In the last year, freight companies have seen a significant upturn in the business. Volumes are up. Billing is up. And in addition to growing demand, we've also seen new constraints on the supply side, with the administration cracking down on who is even allowed on the road. As we know, trucking is an especially cyclical industry, but is this current boom structurally different from past booms? Why is it that despite the boom, many of today's drivers are unhappy with the state of the industry? On this episode, we speak with Reed Loustalot, the chief marketing officer at the the Truck Parking Club, a company which aims to help drivers find parking, so that they're not using up valuable road hours just looking for a place to stop for the night. summary: Representative Mark Pocan (D-WI) discusses the closely contested Democratic gubernatorial primary, where David Crowley narrowly edged out Francesca Hong by a margin of just a few thousand votes. Pocan addresses the implications of this tight race for the upcoming general election against Republican Tom Tiffany, emphasizing the challenges the Democratic Party may face in uniting its base around Crowley. He speaks with Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's “Balance of Power.” (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Fmr. MN Governor on GOP Midterm Races & Party Direction
title_cn: 先生。明尼苏达州州长谈共和党中期选举和政党方向
summary: Former Minnesota Governor Tim Pawlenty analyzes recent GOP primary results, including the defeat of Trump-endorsed Mike Lindell in the Minnesota governor's race. Looking ahead to the general election, he emphasizes that voter concerns will shift from macroeconomic issues to household-level affordability, focusing on energy, healthcare, and groceries. Pawlenty highlights the importance of policies that increase supply, particularly in energy, to help lower costs and appeal to voters in the upcoming midterms. He speaks with Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's “Balance of Power.” (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Colombia Invites US Help on Drug Fight, Trump Defense Chief Says
title_cn: 特朗普国防部长表示哥伦比亚邀请美国帮助打击毒品
summary: Colombia’s new conservative government is partnering with Washington to fight drug gangs in its territory, part of an aggressive US push to coordinate joint military strikes on so-called “narco-terrorism” across the Americas.
